module_summary: Shared-RAM AXI-stream switch: per-input adapters write frames into virtual FIFOs in one arbitrated RAM, a command table issues per-frame read commands to arbitrated output engines that refill output FIFOs.

anchors.name: mem
anchors.why: Shared packet RAM holding all input virtual FIFOs; written by write arbiter, read by read arbiter.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input AXI-stream payload for all S_COUNT ports, fed to per-port width adapters.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-port input stream valid into the ingress adapters.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Per-port input backpressure from ingress adapters, ultimately from FIFO full/command-table space.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdest
anchors.why: Input routing destination decoded into the output port select.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output AXI-stream payload produced by per-output adapters from output FIFOs.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-output stream valid from egress adapters.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Per-output downstream backpressure into egress adapters.

anchors.name: status_overflow
anchors.why: Per-input pulse flagging a frame dropped because the virtual FIFO overflowed.

anchors.name: status_bad_frame
anchors.why: Per-input pulse flagging a frame marked bad by tuser.

anchors.name: status_good_frame
anchors.why: Per-input pulse flagging a frame committed to the virtual FIFO.

anchors.name: ram_wr_sel
anchors.why: Write arbiter's encoded grant selecting which input's address/data writes the RAM.

anchors.name: ram_wr_en
anchors.why: Write arbiter grant_valid enabling the shared RAM write.

anchors.name: ram_rd_sel
anchors.why: Read arbiter's encoded grant selecting which output's read address drives the RAM.

anchors.name: ram_rd_en
anchors.why: Read arbiter grant_valid enabling the RAM read into the read pipeline.

anchors.name: mem_read_data_reg
anchors.why: RAM read data output pipeline stages feeding all outputs.

anchors.name: mem_read_data_valid_reg
anchors.why: One-hot per-output valid accompanying RAM read pipeline data.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].port_axis_tready
anchors.why: Ingress ready combining select valid, RAM write ack, FIFO full and command table space.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].select_reg
anchors.why: Decoded output port index for the current input frame, stored into command table.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].select_valid_reg
anchors.why: Marks a routed frame in progress; gates ingress ready and RAM writes.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].drop_reg
anchors.why: Drops unroutable frame (no matching output) until tlast.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Committed write pointer of the input's virtual FIFO, advanced on good frame end.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].wr_ptr_cur_reg
anchors.why: Speculative in-frame write pointer used as RAM write address; rewound on drop.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO read pointer freed when finished command entries retire.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].full
anchors.why: Virtual FIFO full; throttles ingress ready and triggers frame drop.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].full_wr
anchors.why: Frame larger than FIFO; forces drop of the current packet.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].drop_frame_reg
anchors.why: Holds overflow drop state until tlast, then flags overflow.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].ram_wr_en_reg
anchors.why: Per-input RAM write request to write arbiter, held until ack.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].ram_wr_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds one input word pending RAM write grant.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].ram_wr_addr_reg
anchors.why: RAM write address within the input's virtual FIFO region.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_table_addr_start
anchors.why: Command table of stored frames: start address per entry, with len/select/tkeep/tdest siblings.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_table_active
anchors.why: Per-entry active bits gating command issue and retirement.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_table_commit
anchors.why: Per-entry completion bits set by output status, enabling cleanup.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_table_start_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Command table write pointer; allocates entries on frame commit and limits ingress.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_table_start_en
anchors.why: Writes a new command table entry at good frame end.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_table_read_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Command table read pointer selecting next entry to issue to outputs.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_table_finish_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Retire pointer freeing committed entries and advancing FIFO read pointer.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_valid_reg
anchors.why: One-hot per-output command valid from input to output command arbiters.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_addr_reg
anchors.why: Issued command start RAM address held until accepted.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_len_reg
anchors.why: Issued command frame length held until accepted.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].grant_encoded
anchors.why: Status arbiter grant selecting which output's completion status is accepted.

anchors.name: s_ifaces[*].cmd_status_valid_mux
anchors.why: Arbitrated completion status valid that commits a command table entry.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].grant_encoded
anchors.why: Output command arbiter grant muxing commands from inputs; recorded as source.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].cmd_valid_reg
anchors.why: Output engine busy with an accepted command; gates reads and command acceptance.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].len_reg
anchors.why: Remaining words of the current frame read; zero marks tlast and completion.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: RAM read address of the current command, incremented per issued read.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].src_reg
anchors.why: Source input of the current command, used to route completion status.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].ram_rd_en_reg
anchors.why: Per-output RAM read request to read arbiter, held until ack.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].ram_rd_addr_reg
anchors.why: RAM read address presented to the read arbiter.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].cmd_status_valid_reg
anchors.why: One-hot completion status back to the source input's command table.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].out_fifo_tdata
anchors.why: 32-entry output data FIFO absorbing RAM read latency before egress adapter.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].out_fifo_data_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output data FIFO write pointer advanced on RAM read data valid.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].out_fifo_ctrl_wr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output control FIFO write pointer; limits outstanding reads to 32.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].out_fifo_rd_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Output FIFO read pointer feeding the output register.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].out_axis_tvalid_reg
anchors.why: Valid of registered output beat into egress adapter.

anchors.name: m_ifaces[*].out_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Registered output data word into egress adapter.

groups.name: Ingress adapters and route decode
groups.description: Per-input width adapters and tdest decoder choosing output port or drop.

groups.name: Ingress virtual FIFO writer
groups.description: Per-input pointers, full/drop logic and RAM write requests with frame status.

groups.name: Command table
groups.description: Per-input frame descriptors: allocate, issue commands, commit on status, retire.

groups.name: Shared RAM and arbiters
groups.description: Single RAM with round-robin write and read arbiters and read pipeline.

groups.name: Output command arbitration
groups.description: Per-output arbiter muxing frame commands from all inputs.

groups.name: Output read engine
groups.description: Executes a command: issues RAM reads per word, counts length, returns completion status.

groups.name: Output FIFO and egress adapter
groups.description: Data/control output FIFOs drained into registered beat and width adapter.
